fill_model.fill_from: public prints at our level after the queue ahead is consumed; a print through our level fills at most its printed size
fill_model.name: conservative_queue
fill_model.never: no priority from cancels ahead, no fills inside reaction latency, no fills after TTL, no fills without a forward tape
fill_model.queue_ahead: all displayed size at our level at placement; later snapshots can only raise it

maker_toxicity_verdict.question: Do maker fills show negative 300s markouts (adverse selection) on average?
maker_toxicity_verdict.reason: maker fills were not adversely selected on average

settlement_preview.note: Only fixture markets carry paper_settlement_outcome; archive and network fills are not scored.

tracks.notes: The experiment. Whale-class lifts (large non-block aggressive prints) trigger a same-direction resting bid one tick behind the touch, filled only by the conservative queue model; retail longshot prints with no whale in the lookback trigger the taker fade of the favourite. One ledger, paper caps $25/order, $75/market, $75 daily, $1,000 collateral, conservative marks.
